This note treats that as supplied root research and makes no independent version/source attestation or numeric-threshold diagnosis.

separateReportingGap.justified: Yes, only as failure reporting: src/renderer/index.html:1437-1439 owns an uncaught import('./main.tsx') while the static splash already exists.
separateReportingGap.whyExistingRecoveryCannotHelp: main.tsx imports its eager graph before registerDynamicImportRecovery at line52 can execute. The current utility listens for vite:preloadError and schedules a reload; moving or expanding that retry is excluded.
separateReportingGap.boundedSemantics: If separately chosen, an entry-owned rejection state could retain the original error and display terminal startup failure without importing the failed graph, setting UI-ready, removing the splash as success, retrying, reloading or changing the successful route.
separateReportingGap.qualification: That reporting change would not restore module loading or pass the original cold-renderer E2E. No postimage or selection is made here.

smallestMissingEvidence.beforeFunctionalFix: A source-linked observation of the failing request/allocation boundary is required to choose a functional resource correction. The immediate missing context is which exact request failed in which document/loader, with its bounded observed lifecycle population and whether that observation is complete.
smallestMissingEvidence.cannotRecoverHistorically: The filled96 slots and truncated ResourceTiming subset cannot reconstruct this from the original receipt. No proposed observation is represented as already present.
smallestMissingEvidence.residualLimit: Even a complete CDP target request census would not equal Chromium's per-process live URLLoader accounting or identify a Mojo allocation/keepalive failure. CDP evidence can narrow a hypothesis; a mechanism-specific witness would still be needed before claiming causality.

concreteDiagnosticSeam.currentMechanism: The existing add helper at272-274 keeps the first96 raw events. loadingFailed at307-319 drops requestId; frameNavigated at320-325 already retains frame/loader context separately. Network.enable at364 is already established before the later cold reload.
concreteDiagnosticSeam.proposedScope: An observational side summary in this existing attachment is the narrow seam. Keep the raw events array, ordering, filters and96 cap literally intact; do not replace early events, deduplicate away existing rows, increase the cap or add successful requests into that array.
summarySemantics: Use the existing selected CDP connection and already-enabled Network domain; subscribe passively to requestWillBeSent, loadingFinished and loadingFailed. Add no reload, interception, cache command, target switching, extra browser evaluation, polling, timer or subprocess.

Associate the first failure with bounded opaque requestId/frameId/loaderId, resource type, existing same-origin sanitized pathname and CDP timing. Exclude headers, bodies, query strings and arbitrary console data.

Maintain only a fixed-cap in-memory table for currently observed request IDs plus fixed-size numeric lifecycle totals/peak and a bounded first-failure snapshot. Finished/failed requests retire from the table; redirect/reused IDs must not inflate active counts.

Keep outstanding requests across navigation and classify them by observed loader/frame rather than blindly clearing the table. This is needed to distinguish previous-document activity from the cold document.

Record observation-start/Network-enable and document/loader identity, unmatched terminal events, unavailable fields, counter saturation, table overflow and truncation explicitly. Once completeness is lost, label counts partial/lower-bound/unknown rather than exact.
Freeze the small first-failure context when that event arrives, before later duplicate network logs fill the existing raw cap. Continue bounded aggregate totals without adding raw rows beyond96.
Diagnostic parsing/callback failure must not throw into the scenario or replace its original failure/cleanup. Do not make these counters a new pass condition or authority source.
concreteDiagnosticSeam.boundsLimit: This is a semantic diagnostic proposal, not authored implementation. Any exact fixed map/string/counter limits would be concrete source details if root later selects it; unbounded URL/request histories or a replacement raw log are outside the proposed seam.
concreteDiagnosticSeam.existingFailureCapture: readRendererFailureSnapshot at401-477 remains bounded and captureDesktopRendererFailure keeps its original4000ms snapshot/5000ms screenshot behavior. No new late snapshot is proposed as a substitute for the first-failure event.
concreteDiagnosticSeam.whatItWouldDistinguish: Which cold-load request first failed; the observed request type/path/epoch; whether failures follow substantial still-open selected-target request activity; and whether telemetry was complete. It would not by itself prove memory, FD, per-process2700 cap or allocation-branch cause.

verificationMeaning.onlyIfSelected: Meaningful finite tests would exercise the actual diagnostic attachment's callbacks:96 raw events remain identical/capped; totals continue without unbounded storage; redirect/duplicate/unknown terminal events and navigation do not create false exact counts; overflow is explicit; malformed diagnostics preserve the original scenario failure.
verificationMeaning.noE2eSubstitution: A diagnostic test or entry-rejection test would not qualify cold renderer recovery. The unchanged original reload, full600000-byte/200000-character comment, actual UI controls, canonical Task/command equality and cleanup remain the functional obligations.
verificationMeaning.execution: No implementation, test postimage, runtime, new CI venue, action or protocol gate is selected.
